title: Stored Car Buying Guide: Check the Low-Voltage Battery
meta_description: Assess auxiliary-battery identity, storage history and professional test results before buying a stored car. Keep low-voltage checks separate from EV pack health.
h1: Low-Voltage Battery Checks After a Car Has Been Stored
summary: A single successful start or wake-up is not a complete auxiliary-battery assessment. Track storage history, the actual fitted technology, test findings and any unresolved repeat discharge.
